images.title: Add 10, the root goes up by 1
images.purpose: Shows the core move of the practice: adding 10, whose digital root is 1, raises a digital root of 5 to 6.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Two boxes left and right joined by one arrow.
images.exact_structure: Left rounded box: number, with a tag root 5 under it in teal (#0072B2). Right rounded box: number + 10, with a tag root 6 under it in reddish purple (#CC79A7). One amber (#E69F00) arrow from left to right labelled +10 adds 1. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Adding a number adds its digital root to the digital root.
images.description: Shows the core move of the practice: adding 10, whose digital root is 1, raises a digital root of 5 to 6.

image_decisions.why: One arrow shows how digital roots add, the key move of this practice.
